In that game, Saransh took three wickets. Madhya Pradesh spinner Saransh Jain took a seven-wicket haul against Bihar in the Ranji Trophy third round of fixtures on Monday. Saransh’s spell of 7/40, his career-best innings figures in First-Class cricket, helped MP bowl out Bihar for 99. Saransh recently turned out for India in the second Test against Sri Lanka between August 23 and 27. In that match, Saransh took three wickets. It remains his only international appearance to date. The 33-year-old has played 59 FC matches for Madhya Pradesh, in which he has taken 195 wickets at an average of 28.23.
